description: This file defines the 'Policy' interface and related functions for the Kubernetes Topology Manager, including merging topology hints, filtering hints, and selecting optimal NUMA node affinities for pod placement.

classes.name: HintMerger
classes.description: Struct for merging topology hints with NUMA node information and comparison logic.

classes.name: TopologyHint
classes.description: Struct representing a topology hint with NUMA node affinity and preference status.

methods.name: mergePermutation
methods.description: Merges a permutation of topology hints into a single hint by bitwise AND of affinities.

methods.name: filterProvidersHints
methods.description: Filters and accumulates hints from multiple providers, inserting default hints when necessary.

methods.name: narrowestHint
methods.description: Finds the narrowest (most specific) topology hint based on NUMA affinity.

methods.name: maxOfMinAffinityCounts
methods.description: Calculates the maximum count of NUMA nodes among the narrowest hints for each resource.

methods.name: NewHintMerger
methods.description: Constructs a HintMerger with NUMA info, hints, policy name, and options.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Compares two topology hints to select the better based on preference and affinity.

methods.name: Merge
methods.description: Performs the merging of hints across all providers to produce a single topology hint.

methods.name: iterateAllProviderTopologyHints
methods.description: Recursively iterates over all permutations of provider hints, applying a callback.
